title: Parsing a traceback taken from a log crashes when the tail is missing
title_original: fix(tbutils): avoid IndexError in ParsedException.from_string on truncated tracebacks
text_original:
`ParsedException.from_string` raises `IndexError` when the last frame has a source line but no following line (a truncated traceback with no exception line). The anchor-handling added in #332 unconditionally reads `tb_lines[line_no + 1]`, which overruns the list.

```python
from boltons.tbutils import ParsedException
ParsedException.from_string('''Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 3, in <module>
    print(add(1, 2))''')
# IndexError: list index out of range
```

The anchor lookahead is now bounds-checked and only runs after a source line was consumed (anchors only follow source lines). The main loop also stops once the lines are exhausted instead of relying on an out-of-range access. Added a regression test; existing tbutils tests still pass.
text_rewritten:
We feed traceback text scraped out of log files into the traceback-parsing helper. Whenever the captured text stops after the last source line — no closing "SomeError: message" line, because the log was rotated or the field was truncated — the parser raises IndexError instead of returning what it could read. One truncated record takes down the whole batch.

A clipped traceback should parse into the frames it does contain, including the case where it stops immediately after a frame header. A complete traceback must keep round-tripping to exactly the text it came from.
body:
We feed traceback text scraped out of log files into the traceback-parsing helper. Whenever the captured text stops after the last source line — no closing "SomeError: message" line, because the log was rotated or the field was truncated — the parser raises IndexError instead of returning what it could read. One truncated record takes down the whole batch.

A clipped traceback should parse into the frames it does contain, including the case where it stops immediately after a frame header. A complete traceback must keep round-tripping to exactly the text it came from.
acceptance_hint: Parsing a traceback whose text ends before the exception line returns the frames it does contain instead of raising, and a complete traceback still round-trips to the identical text.
